title: 第007章 猎山鸡第008章 词条 羽落
slug: 我能给箭术加点从猎户到斩仙
content_zh:
他是真怕啊！
昨天这小儿子刚刚好转了一点。
他昨晚睡得都香了不少。
怎么这一晚上又变回去了？
李玄转过身，面对家人担忧、惊恐、困惑的目光。
脸上那夸张的认真和“深情”
瞬间褪去。
恢复了平静，甚至带着一丝淡淡的嘲讽。
“爹，大哥，嫂子，你们放心。”
他语气平稳，却带着一种不容置疑的坚定，
“那三十两，我一文都不会给。
刚才那番话，不过是说给那贪财的媒婆和徐家听的。”
他看着家人不解的眼神，解释道：
“徐家不是想要面子，想攀比吗？我就把面子给他们撑到天上去！
一百两，金玉锦缎，他们听得高兴，媒婆跑得欢实。
至于这聘礼……”
他嘴角勾起一抹冷笑：
“让他们等着去吧。
等他们反应过来我是在耍他们，或者等我‘永远’也攒不够这笔钱的时候，着急难堪的是他们，不是我们。”
“至少，短时间内，他们不会再用二十两、三十两这种‘小钱’来烦我们了。

省得那媒婆隔三差五上门聒噪。”
他顿了顿，目光扫过破败的家，声音低沉下来：
“以前是我混账，被猪油蒙了心，为了个不值得的女人，把家里折腾成这样。
以后不会了。”
他拿起靠在墙边的破桑木弓，掂了掂：
“我现在只想着一件事——怎么用这双手，让家里吃上饱饭，让爹的病好起来，让秀儿能穿上新衣，让大哥和嫂子不用天天为了一口吃的发愁。”
李忠张了张嘴，看着弟弟平静却坚毅的侧脸，眼圈忽然有点发红。
王氏也愣住了，看着李玄，第一次觉得这个小叔子身上。
好像真的有了点“当家男人”
的担当感。
“真……真的？”
李山没说话，只是深深地看着李玄，握着拐杖的手，微微松了些力气。
眼底深处，那点困惑渐渐化开。
取而代之的是一种沉甸甸的、混合着欣慰和难以置信的复杂情绪。
半响后，才骂了一句，
“臭小子……演的挺好，连你爹都骗过去了。”
content_en:
He is so scared!
The little son just got a little better yesterday.
He slept very soundly last night.
Why did it change back again this night?
Li Xuan turned around and faced the worried, frightened and confused eyes of his family.
The exaggerated seriousness and "affection" on his face
Fades instantly.
He regained his composure, even with a hint of sarcasm.
"Dad, eldest brother, sister-in-law, don't worry."
His tone was calm, but with an unquestionable firmness.
“I won’t give you a cent of those thirty taels.
What I just said was just for the money-grubbing matchmaker and the Xu family. "
He looked at the puzzled looks in his family's eyes and explained:
"Don't the Xu family want face and comparison? I will give them face to the sky!
One hundred taels, gold and jade brocade, they were happy to hear it, and the matchmaker ran away happily.
As for this betrothal gift..."
A sneer appeared at the corner of his mouth:
“Let them wait.
When they realize that I am playing tricks on them, or that I will never save enough money, they will be the ones who are anxious and embarrassed, not us. "
“At least, in a short period of time, they won’t bother us with ‘little money’ like twenty taels or thirty taels.
This saves the matchmaker from coming to the house every now and then to make noise. "
He paused, his eyes swept over the dilapidated home, and his voice deepened:
"I used to be a bastard. I was blinded by lard, and I ruined my family like this for an unworthy woman.
Not anymore. "
He picked up the broken mulberry bow leaning against the wall and weighed it:
"I'm only thinking about one thing now - how to use these hands to provide enough food for the family, to help my father recover from his illness, so that Xiu'er can wear new clothes, and so that my eldest brother and sister-in-law don't have to worry about a mouthful of food every day."
Li Zhong opened his mouth and looked at his brother's calm but resolute profile, his eye circles suddenly turned a little red.
Mrs. Wang was also stunned. Looking at Li Xuan, it was the first time she felt this brother-in-law.
It seems that I really have a "man in charge"
sense of responsibility.
"Really...really?"
Li Shan did not speak, but looked deeply at Li Xuan, holding the crutch in his hand and relaxing slightly.
Deep in his eyes, the confusion gradually dissipated.
What replaced it was a heavy complex emotion of relief and disbelief.
After a while, he cursed,
"You brat...he acted very well. He even deceived your father."
